sources.title: LFM2.5-Encoder-350M - Liquid Docs
sources.snippet: At 350M parameters, it is the larger sibling in the encoder family, built for maximum downstream quality when fine-tuned into task-specific models (classification, token classification, retrieval, reranking, and semantic similarity) across 15 languages. HF Use LFM2.5-Encoder-350M when downstream quality matters most.

sources.title: LFM2.5-350M: No Size Left Behind — Blog — Liquid AI
sources.snippet: LFM2.5-350M: No Size Left Behind Today, we're releasing LFM2.5-350M, an improved version of our 350M model with additional pre-training (from 10T to 28T tokens) and large-scale reinforcement learning. Built on the LFM2 architecture, it delivers exceptionally fast inference and runs everywhere, from cloud GPUs to cheap CPUs.

sources.title: LFM2.5-Embedding-350M - Liquid Docs
sources.snippet: 350M dense bi-encoder model for multilingual retrieval and semantic search ← Back to Liquid Nanos LFM2.5-Embedding-350M is a dense bi-encoder retrieval model that produces one 1024-dimensional vector per query or document. It is built for fast, compact multilingual and cross-lingual semantic search across 11 languages.
